typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{PHONE NUMBER} as string,
		{CONTROLLING PREFERNCE OPTION} as string,
		{CELL PHONE INDICATOR} as string,
		{REFERENCE NUMBER} as string,
		{RECORD STATUS} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(PHONE NUMBER == 'TR', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(FooterRow,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput sink(input(
		REFERENCE_ID as string,
		CELL_PHONE_INDICATOR as string,
		ANTHEM_PREFERENCE as string,
		PHONE as string,
		RECORD_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		REFERENCE_ID = {REFERENCE NUMBER},
		CELL_PHONE_INDICATOR = {CELL PHONE INDICATOR},
		ANTHEM_PREFERENCE = {CONTROLLING PREFERNCE OPTION},
		PHONE = {PHONE NUMBER},
		RECORD_STATUS = {RECORD STATUS})) ~> TNMONOCPSUISCRUBOUTSTAGING
